evals.prompt: Starting my day. What was I doing and what's next?
evals.expected_output: Chains wake-up, next-priority, pr-snapshot and conditionally context-pack, then recommends one first move.
assertions: Phase 1 runs wake-up for the compact brief (latest handoff, top RAG hits, git status, recent memory)
Phase 3 runs pr-snapshot with ready / waiting / blocked and ages
Phase 4 context-pack only fires if next-priority returned a work item and the prompt mentions implement, refactor or fix
Ends with 'Today's first move' including why, skill to invoke and expected effort

evals.prompt: New session. Load context and tell me where we stand before I start fixing the flaky test.
evals.expected_output: Includes the conditional context-pack since the intent is to fix.
assertions: Invokes context-pack because the prompt carries fix intent
Synthesizes phases 1 to 4 into one recommendation

evals.prompt: Continue implementing the retry logic we were just writing.
evals.expected_output: Mid-task continuation, not a start-of-day routine.
assertions: Does not run the full bootstrap chain
